$comment: Performance budgets CI holds the app to (TA-35). Raise one only on purpose, in the same pull request as the change that needs it, and say why there.

bundle.$comment: Gzipped bytes of each Vite entry in public/build/manifest.json, and of all of them together. Measured 2026-11-24: app.css 42,571, passkeys.js 3,895, app.js 20.

load.$comment: k6 against the full Docker stack (proxy, two production-like app nodes), 25 virtual users (TA-31's load test used 25 concurrent) for 30 s per scenario. Each scenario must stay under its p95_ms, average at least its rps over its 30 s, and fail no request. Set 2026-11-28 from GitHub's runner, where two runs of near-identical code differed by about 20% on every scenario alike (central homepage 251 and 195 req/s, p95 172 and 235 ms; agency homepage 217 and 178 req/s, p95 188 and 224 ms; signed-in dashboard 113 and 94 req/s, p95 331 and 415 ms): each budget is the slower run with about 20% more room. A run also fails when a scenario is more than regression_margin worse than main's last run, so that margin sits above the runner's own swing.

lighthouse.$comment: Lowest category scores, 0 to 1, on every page lighthouserc.json lists.
